summary.text: Wendy Dant Chesser is a Democratic state representative from Indiana House District 71 who was appointed to the seat in 2024 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
Ballotpedia lists Republican James McClure Jr. as her opponent in the general election.

paragraphs.text: Wendy Dant Chesser graduated from Jeffersonville High School and holds a bachelor of science in business management from Indiana University Southeast.
She previously worked as chief director of corporate strategy and external affairs at the River Ridge Development Authority.

In a 2026 Ballotpedia survey, she said she served in the O'Bannon/Kernan administration, led the Indiana Rural Development Council, spent eight years at a nonprofit in Michigan, and in 2012 returned to lead One Southern Indiana.
The Indiana Democratic Party appointed Dant Chesser to the seat on May 29, 2024, to replace Rita Fleming, and she took office on June 4, 2024.
She won the November 2024 general election with 49.6 percent of the vote, ahead of Republican Scott Hawkins and Libertarian Gregory Hertzsch.
For 2025-2026, Ballotpedia lists her on the Commerce, Small Business and Economic Development, Financial Institutions and Insurance, Insurance, and Roads and Transportation committees.
In the 2026 survey, she listed restoring trust and accountability, creating opportunity for Hoosiers, and education and workforce development as her key campaign messages.
